ir.name: pairwise_pref_cost_weighted_sigmoid
ir.intuition: The original loss was too similar to existing pairwise preference losses because it used a simple linear difference of log probabilities weighted by cost_gap. To improve novelty and better leverage the quality signal, this repair integrates cost_gap into a sigmoid weighting, modulating the preference score nonlinearly and capturing margin effects. The weight is combined multiplicatively for scaling. This yields a more nuanced gradient signal sensitive to cost differences and enforces preference in a pairwise sigmoid margin-based manner, maintaining vectorized ops and required expects.
ir.pseudocode:
pref = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
weighted_pref = weight * ops.logsigmoid(cost_gap * pref)
loss = -ops.mean(weighted_pref)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    log_prob_w = batch['log_prob_w']
    log_prob_l = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']
    pref = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
    # Modulate preference by cost_gap to encode margin-based preference strength
    scored_pref = ops.logsigmoid(cost_gap * pref)
    weighted_pref = weight * scored_pref
    loss = -ops.mean(weighted_pref)
    return loss
